titulo: Polls open in Holborn and St Pancras byelection – UK politics live
cuerpo: Voters choosing replacement for Keir Starmer, who announced he was standing down last month The UK’s military is too focused on global commitments at the expense of domestic defence, meaning the government’s planned increase in defence spending is likely to result in even greater waste, a thinktank report has warned. According to an analysis by researchers at the Transition Security Project , Britain has the most overseas-oriented military among European nations, with almost a quarter of the defence budget spent on commitments across five continents.
